propositions: Structurally divergent LLM provider/model responses can normalize to empty verification results that were previously treated as valid review outcomes

Empty verification outcomes occur via two paths: raw-empty (no list returned despite non-empty chunk indices) and malformed-to-empty (non-empty raw list where all items are dropped by reshape_verifications)
The decision layer already routes any finding with no verification entry to indeterminate status, regardless of whether absence came from raw-empty or malformed-to-empty path

Telemetry must distinguish four outcome buckets (clean, recovered, empty_outcomes, unrecoverable) at kernel-function level in verify_findings, but pipeline-level wiring into plan_review_decide and code_review_decide is incomplete
Semantic emptiness is defined as a finding index having no verification entry in the reshaped verifications list after chunking and reshape

The shipped verify_findings kernel function already implements empty-outcome detection and StructuredOutputError handling with comprehensive telemetry and unit test coverage, but live consumer pipelines do not yet call it for telemetry emission
